(NYSE: LION) today reported second quarter results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported second quarter revenue of $668.8 million, operating income of $29.1 million and net loss from continuing operations attributable to shareholders of $15.5 million, or $0.05 diluted net loss per share on 298 million diluted weighted average common shares outstanding.
